newsitem.title: USA: Charter One to buy RCSB for $635 mln stk.
newsitem.headline: Charter One to buy RCSB for $635 mln stk.

text.p: Charter One Financial Inc, holding company of Charter One Bank, said Wednesday that it has reached a definitive agreement to acquire RCSB Financial Inc, holding company of Rochester Community Savings Bank, for $635 million in Charter One stock.

Terms of the agreement call for a tax-free exchange of shares at a fixed exchange ratio of 0.91 shares of Charter One stock for each RCSB common share. Based on Charter One's May 19 stock price of 46-5/8, the exchange ratio represents a price of $42.429 for each share of RCSB, which closed Wednesday at 34.
The merger is to be accounted for as a pooling of interests and is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1997, said Charter One.
Charter One expects that the transaction will be accretive to earnings based on cost savings alone, which it said should total between $21 million and $25 million annually.
About 13.6 million new shares will be issued in conjunction with the merger, said the bank.
It also said it will take a one-time aftertax charge of between $50 million and $60 million for expnses assoicated with the merger.

The bank said that due diligence work has been completed by both companies and their advisors, and the transaction has been approved by directors of both companies. The merger is still subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.

Upon completion of the merger Rochester Community Savings Bank would be merged into Charter One Bank, but its retail banking offices would remain open and continue to operate under the Rochester Community name.

Headquartered in Rochester, New York, RCSB Financial, Inc is the holding company for Rochester Community Savings Bank, a $4 billion savings bank with primary business lines in retail banking, mortgage banking and automobile lending.

With approximately $14 billion in total assets, Charter One Bank is one of the largest thrifts in the country with 94 branches in Ohio operating under the name Charter One Bank and 80 branches in Michigan operating under the name First Federal of Michigan.
